description: YHEPgrout-2106 High Penetration Modified Epoxy Resin Grout is a solvent-free, two-component, low-viscosity liquid formulated with hyperbranched high-strength epoxy resins. It is specially designed for injection into voids and cracks in concrete to deliver long-term sealing and reinforcement of concrete structures.
whereToUse: It is used to fill and seal cavities and cracks in structural concrete, such as columns, beams, foundations, decks and water-retaining structures
subways, high-speed rail, tunnels, utility corridors and buildings
concrete crack sealing, deformation joint sealing, construction joint sealing
concrete pavement reinforcement, bridge grouting reinforcement
underwater concrete reinforcement and repair for bridge piers and docks
advantages: Low viscosity and excellent permeability, suitable for injection into fine cracks.
High solid content with solvent-free formulation for safety and environmental friendliness.
Good curing and bonding performance under water; enables direct injection for minor water seepage.
High strength and good toughness after curing, resistant to thermal expansion and contraction of concrete.
Excellent impermeability and waterproof performance of cured grout.
High mechanical strength of cured material: effectively stops minor water seepage while delivering structural reinforcement.
notFor: If there is significant water seepage or water inflow, other grouting materials should first be used for leak sealing before proceeding with grouting.
dual-liquid grouting pump is not recommended
Do not add any thinners to this product.
Construction should be carried out in well-ventilated conditions, and appropriate safety measures should be taken by the personnel.

standards.value: Epoxy Resin Grout for Concrete Cracks: liquid Type N and curing Type II

technicalData.label: Component A
technicalData.value: colourless to light yellow transparent liquid

technicalData.label: Hole layout
technicalData.value: Drill 45° angled holes at 25-30 cm intervals along both sides of the crack.

technicalData.label: Storage temperature
technicalData.value: The maximum storage temperature should not exceed 40°C.

technicalData.label: Shelf life
technicalData.value: not less than 12 months from the date of manufacture

mixing: Mix components A and B in a mass ratio of 2:1 in a dry, clean mixing cup.
packaging: Component A: 10 kg / 10 L per drum; Component B: 10 kg / 10 L per drum
storage: The product should be stored in a cool, dry place and kept sealed.
